items.title: Aid cuts left global health groups reeling. Will donors step in?
items.summary: A survey of 461 organizations in 73 countries finds that global health and civil society groups are struggling after aid cuts starting in 2025, and more than half say they would not be financially viable in two years. About $600 million was cut from family planning and reproductive health programs.
